(AP Photo/Eugene Hoshiko)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Ben Axelson | baxelson@syracuse.comThe 2026 World Baseball Classic quarterfinals continue, with a showdown between Venezuela and Japan, led by global superstar Shohei Ohtani, wrapping the stage on Saturday, March 14 (3/14/2026) at 9 p.m. ET. Here’s how to watch the World Baseball Classic today, for free.How to watch World Baseball ClassicThe 2026 World Baseball Classic airs on Fox Sports and FOX networks, and streams live on fuboTV (free trial), which offers $25 off your first month after your free trial ends.fuboTV$73.99$48.99Stream local and national sports with your free trial of fuboTV, and get $25 off your first month.Start for freeWhat: World Baseball Classic, quarterfinalWho: Venezuela vs. JapanWhen: Saturday, March 14, 2026 (3/14/2026)Where: LoanDepot Park, Miami, FloridaTime: 9 p.m. ETTV: FOXLive stream: fuboTV (free trial), DIRECTV (free trial), Hulu + Live TVAll columns visible (no scrolling needed)The best way to watch the World Baseball Classic for free is with a free trial of fuboTV, which includes a free trial and $25 off your first month of service. Fans who sign up on Friday will enjoy five days of free trial, allowing them to watch games through the end of the tournament. DIRECTV offers a similar free trial, but that service has a higher base cost and currently only offers $10 off your first three months, making it a more expensive way to enjoy the entire tournament. The offer is good for new customers only, and cannot be applied to returning customers.Sling works for select games, but does not include FOX in most markets, making it a less-desirable option for fans who want to stream as many games as possible.What to know about the World Baseball ClassicShohei Ohtani is back at Miami’s loanDepot Park, the site of the knockout rounds of this year’s World Baseball Classic, which he calls one of his favorite stadiums. It’s the place where he delivered two of baseball’s quintessential moments from the last few years, getting the final out for Japan in the 2023 WBC championship game and creating baseball’s 50-50 club with a show for all time in Miami in 2024 as well.Japan finished World Baseball Classic pool play unbeaten, topping the Czechs 9-0 behind Munetaka Murakami’s grand slam. At 4–0 with a 39–9 run margin, Japan advanced to a quarterfinal in Miami against Venezuela. Ohtani rested after an already dominant tournament.The Czechs concluded the event winless, scoring only five total runs and batting .167. Kenya Wakatsuki’s go‑ahead double and Ukyo Shuto’s three‑run homer opened the decisive rally, followed by additional runs that set up Murakami’s blast. Czech starter Ondrej Satoria allowed six hits before exiting and is well known in Japan for striking out Ohtani in 2023. Winner Yumeto Kanemaru pitched two perfect innings.The Czech team—made up entirely of players with day jobs—emphasized their commitment to competing professionally despite their amateur backgrounds.Now Japan squares off with a much tougher Venezuelan side, which finished 3-1 in pool play, losing only to the star-studded Dominican Republic.
